items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Irving Miller, Brown Skin Models. [INTERVIEWER] Irving Miller was the producer. [INTERVIEWEE] Producer, yeah, he had Brown Skin Models.

ctx.x: Go on and tell me about Eubie Blake, 1918.

Eubie I met, I met him some show and we did -- oh, he was in Shuffle Along and 63rd Street and they went down to Baltimore somewhere and got stranded and they didn't do so good and come on back and then he came up to -- he come in the theatre. Irving Miller, Brown Skin Models.
